home.title: JSON Toolkit
home.meta_title: Online JSON Toolkit - Format, Convert, Validate, and Decode JWT
home.subtitle: Format, minify, diff, convert, validate, and inspect JSON in your browser. Includes JSON/YAML/XML/CSV/Excel/TypeScript conversion, JSON Schema, JSONPath, and JWT tools. Your data stays local and is never uploaded.
home.privacy_note: All processing runs locally in your browser. Input data is not uploaded to a server.

faq.privacy_q: Does JSON Toolkit upload my data?
faq.privacy_a: No. Formatting, conversion, analysis, JWT parsing, and file processing run locally in your browser. The server does not receive your input.
faq.formats_a: JSON, YAML, XML, CSV, Excel, TypeScript interfaces, JSON Schema, JSONPath, and JWT are supported.
faq.free_q: Are these tools free to use?
faq.free_a: Yes. The tools are free, require no account, and the project is open source.
faq.loose_q: Does the JSON formatter support loose syntax?
faq.loose_a: Yes. It accepts common loose input such as unquoted object keys and single-quoted strings for faster debugging.

not_found.title: Page not found
not_found.description: This address does not exist, or the tool has moved. You can return home or continue with one of the popular JSON tools.

json-format.name: JSON Formatter
json-format.description: Format, minify, and validate JSON with tree view and node operations

json-escape.name: JSON Escape
json-escape.description: Minify and escape JSON for embedding in strings, or unescape back
json-escape.placeholder: Enter JSON or an escaped string...

json-repair.name: JSON Repair / Clean
json-repair.description: Fix comments, trailing commas, single quotes, unquoted keys, and other common JSON issues
json-repair.placeholder: Paste JSON with comments, trailing commas, or loose syntax...

json-diff.name: JSON Diff
json-diff.description: Visually compare two JSON documents, highlighting additions, removals, and changes
json-diff.identical: The two JSON documents are identical
json-diff.left_placeholder: Paste the original JSON, such as an object with a set to 1
json-diff.right_placeholder: Paste the new JSON, such as an object with an added b field

json-yaml.name: JSON ↔ YAML
json-yaml.description: Convert between JSON and YAML formats
json-yaml.json_placeholder: Paste a JSON object, such as a key/value config

json-xml.name: JSON ↔ XML
json-xml.description: Convert between JSON and XML formats
json-xml.json_placeholder: Paste a JSON object, such as name and age fields

json-to-csv.name: JSON → CSV
json-to-csv.description: Export a JSON array as a CSV file
json-to-csv.placeholder: Paste a JSON array, such as rows with col1 / col2 fields

json-to-excel.name: JSON → Excel
json-to-excel.description: Export a JSON array as an Excel (.xlsx) file
json-to-excel.placeholder: Paste a JSON array, such as rows with a col1 field
json-to-excel.idle_desc: Enter a JSON array and click Download Excel

excel-to-json.name: Excel → JSON
excel-to-json.description: Read an Excel (.xlsx/.xls) file and convert it to a JSON array
excel-to-json.empty_output: Result will appear after uploading a file

json-to-ts.name: JSON → TypeScript
json-to-ts.description: Infer and generate TypeScript interface types from JSON
json-to-ts.placeholder: Paste a JSON sample, such as id and name fields

json-flatten.name: JSON Flatten / Unflatten
json-flatten.description: Flatten nested JSON into path keys, or restore nested structures from path keys
json-flatten.placeholder: Paste nested JSON, such as user.name and a roles array

json-schema.name: JSON Schema Generator
json-schema.description: Automatically infer a JSON Schema from a sample JSON document
json-schema.placeholder: Paste a JSON sample, such as id and name fields

json-schema-validate.name: JSON Schema Validator
json-schema-validate.description: Validate JSON data against a JSON Schema and show error paths and reasons
json-schema-validate.json_placeholder: Paste the JSON data to validate, such as id and name fields
json-schema-validate.schema_placeholder: Paste JSON Schema, such as object, required, and properties rules

json-path.name: JSONPath Query
json-path.description: Extract nested fields using JSONPath expressions
json-path.empty_output: Enter a path and click Query

json-stats.name: JSON Stats
json-stats.description: Analyze JSON structure: nesting depth, key count, type distribution, size comparison

jwt.name: JWT Parser
jwt.description: Decode JWT tokens, inspect Header / Payload, and verify HS256 signatures
jwt.empty_output: Paste a JWT token and click Decode
